screens.heading: Dry ground waits
screens.body: After a dry day, the ground holds tiny bits that smell like earth.

screens.heading: Raindrops splash up
screens.body: When raindrops hit, they splash those bits into the air. Scientists call that smell petrichor.

petrichor.meaning: The earthy smell when rain hits dry ground.
petrichor.example: Like breathing in right after a summer storm on the sidewalk.

screens.heading: Your nose knows
screens.body: Your nose catches it fast — like a secret the sidewalk was saving for you.

screens.heading: Try it next time
screens.body: Next time it rains, take one slow breath. That good smell? You know its name now.

comprehension.question: What is petrichor?
choices: The earthy smell when rain hits dry ground

comprehension.question: What happens when raindrops hit dry ground?
choices: Tiny earthy bits splash into the air

video.prompt: Watch a short clip of rain on dry pavement. What do you see and smell in your mind?
